modern: Quarrels of little children and their games, and poor spirits carrying about dead bodies—such is everything; and so what is shown in the representation of the dwellings of the dead strikes our eyes more clearly.
original: Quarrels of little children and their sports, and poor spirits carrying about dead bodies [such is everything]; and so what is exhibited in the representation of the mansions of the dead strikes our eyes more clearly.

notification_original: Quarrels of little children and their sports, and poor spirits carrying about dead bodies [such is everything]…

explained.summary: Human affairs are like children squabbling and playing, or like little souls hauling corpses about. Marcus is borrowing an image from Epictetus of a person as a small soul carrying a dead body. Seen that way, the gloomy pictures of the underworld seem almost more true to life than our self-important bustle.
